mintAuthority.summary: JLTXX issues natively on Ethereum (FactTokenDiamond) and Solana (SPL Token-2022). On Ethereum, single-owner LightAccounts hold TOKENIZATION_AGENT minting and diamond-owner upgrade rights with zero delay. On Solana, a single keypair holds mint, freeze, permanent-delegate, pause, and transfer-hook authorities with no cryptographic quorum, supply cap, or local timelock. Beneficial key custody and independent fund-to-token reconciliation remain undisclosed.
mintAuthority.headline: Single-owner accounts can mint or replace issuance logic immediately; no on-chain collateral ceiling or independent signing quorum is established.
